name: Evil People
overview: Scripture reveals that God is opposed to wickedness and does not take pleasure in evil, as He is holy and righteous (Psalms 5:4). Believers are encouraged not to envy or fret over evildoers, trusting that the Lord will fight on their behalf and bring justice in His perfect timing (Exodus 14:14; Psalms 37:1). While God sovereignly creates both light and darkness, He declares that there is no peace for the wicked, highlighting the ultimate futility of evil (Isaiah 45:7; Isaiah 48:22). Even when the prosperity of the wicked seems apparent, God’s righteous judgment remains sure, reminding us to place our hope in His sovereign justice rather than in the fleeting success of evil people (Jeremiah 12:1).
